title: Bias-aware BiLSTM toxicity ensemble
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments into word and punctuation tokens, truncates them to 320 tokens, and builds a training-only vocabulary of up to 200,000 tokens occurring at least twice. A learned 300-dimensional embedding feeds two stacked bidirectional LSTMs. Masked mean and max pooling are concatenated, passed through two residual ReLU linear layers, and used for a toxicity logit plus auxiliary identity-label logits. Training uses three seeded model variants, length-bucketed shuffled batches, Adam, mixed-precision loss scaling, gradient clipping, and a cosine-decayed learning rate over four epochs. The primary BCE-with-logits loss uses weights that emphasize identity-subgroup and subgroup/label-mismatch cases; masked auxiliary BCE for identity columns is added equally. Validation inference applies sigmoid probabilities. Predictions from epochs 1 onward across all members are retained and averaged as probabilities for the final output.
